Current whole1826 explains the privately profitable price/output restriction relative to supplied competition and checks the boundary under an enforced licence. actualWholeContractFit.case1OwnAnswer: Among the supplied three choices, price60/output40 yields the maximum profit1600. It exceeds the competitive reference price20 and lowers supply from100 to40. Under the stated lack of substitutes and entry, privately profitable restriction can leave mutually beneficial trades unmade. The data permit a choice among the options, not a continuous monopoly optimum or numeric welfare-loss claim.
actualWholeContractFit.case2OwnAnswer: Without the binding licence10/30 yields150 and5/50 yields0, so the former is preferred. Under the enforced licence the choice is fixed to5/50, capacity suffices and costs are covered; supply matches the supplied competition reference. A single firm does not prove actual restriction.
actualWholeContractFit.sourceOverlap: Both supplied responses explicitly check the consequences and validity boundary of a market result. The mechanism is an authored selected example within the broad result-checking expectation.
actualWholeContractFit.sourceRemainingFacets: The broader range of market results and social market principles remains on the existing unions; one mechanism cannot fully exhaust it.
